title: lm(y ~ x): intercept 0, slope 2
caption: The five points (1, 2) to (5, 10) lie exactly on y = 2x, so coef(fit) gives intercept 0 and slope 2 and R² is 1, a perfect fit.
alt: Five points on the straight line y = 2x from (1, 2) to (5, 10), with the fitted line through them all.
description: Plot the five points x = 1:5 against y = 2, 4, 6, 8, 10.
Every point lies on one straight line.
The fitted line has intercept 0 and slope 2.
The fit is perfect, so R² = 1.
